把页面内的信息展开与窗口边缘的临时层拆成两个公共组合身份。QToolBox、QDockWidget 与 QDialog 只提供可核对的 Qt 行为，不替代业务级折叠、遮罩、推移、焦点返回和关闭策略。
FIGMA VERIFIED / 28 DESCRIBED VARIANTS / 18 OF 22 TOKENS BOUND / 4 RUNTIME-ONLY
历史映射把 QToolBox 直接标为 Collapse、把 QDockWidget 适配为 Drawer；本页将这两处降级为实现参照，并把不可由原生类推导的产品语义写成显式合同。
QToolBox 只有一个 currentIndex；Collapse 默认可多开，也允许全部收起。只在 accordion 模式下才共享“单一展开项”约束。
QDockWidget 依赖 QMainWindow 停靠区，可浮动成顶层窗口；OverlayDrawer 是页面或窗口内的覆盖/推移临时层。
QDialog 可承载模态阻断与完成结果，但 Drawer 的四边定位、遮罩命中、push 和嵌套层级仍需专用适配器。
ComponentLab/Collapse 具备 12 个根变体；ComponentLab/OverlayDrawer 具备 16 个根变体。两者共复用 66 个规范 Label / Button 实例，并通过 22 个 QtLab/Runtime 组件别名覆盖四配置；activeKeys、关闭原因、焦点返回与内容生命周期仍由运行时合同负责。
items 具有稳定 key；activeKeys 为集合。Accordion 只允许一个 key；Multi 允许多个或空集合。
默认隐藏而不销毁；延迟构造、force render 与 destroy-on-hide 必须成为独立策略，不能从视觉推断。
关闭按钮、Esc、遮罩点击和业务拦截分别治理；关闭后焦点返回触发源，嵌套抽屉维持 LIFO。
Overlay 覆盖主内容；Push 改变内容几何。两者不得和 QDockWidget 的用户拖拽、浮动与停靠恢复混为一谈。
Left / Right 以宽度为主，Top / Bottom 以高度为主；RTL 不自动交换业务 placement，必须由产品合同决定。

pages.name: 20.8.01 · Alert, Message & Notification / 警告、消息与通知
galleries: States · default / hover / selected / disabled / custom
Three feedback channels with distinct interruption, lifetime, placement, and Qt composition contracts.
FIGMA VERIFIED / 29 VARIANTS / 33 COMPONENT TOKENS BOUND / RUNTIME OPEN
Do not collapse the three feedback channels
Alert stays in page flow and may persist. Message is a light top-center transient with queue rules. Notification is a richer corner card with placement, action, and screen-reader semantics.
Persistent inline or banner container. Four semantic types, icon/close/action controls, no global queue.
Top-center, non-blocking, auto-dismiss feedback. Five semantic types including loading and queue limits.
Complex global feedback at viewport corners. Title, description, close/action and placement are contractual.
29 governed variants across three public component sets. Twelve editable properties and 53 nested canonical Button instances preserve a stable composition contract.
ComponentLab/Alert · 8 variants · 5 properties · 16 canonical Button instances
ComponentLab/Message · 5 variants · 2 properties · 5 canonical Button instances
ComponentLab/Notification · 16 variants · 5 properties · 32 canonical Button instances

No repository-native Alert, Message, or Notification public identity exists. QStatusBar can show temporary messages, but remains a QMainWindow status surface and cannot replace overlay Message or Notification. QMessageBox remains the bounded standard dialog asset.

Alert, Message, and Notification retain distinct flow, queue, placement, and assistive semantics. All 33 component tokens now bind directly; two supporting success primitives resolve through aliases. Runtime still owns queues, timing, stacking, focus-safe dismissal, and Qt host APIs.

29 described variants; 12 editable properties; 53 canonical Button instances; 35 described, specifically scoped, WEB-valid variables; 33 component tokens directly bound; text resize, keyboard, screen-reader, runtime screenshots, automated Qt tests, public API documentation, and category synchronization required.

pages.name: 20.9.01 · Dialog & MessageDialog / 对话框与消息对话框
galleries: States · default / hover / selected / disabled / custom
建立通用对话框窗口壳与标准消息对话框的独立合同。业务 Modal 是 Dialog 的模态使用方式；QMessageBox 只负责告知、提问与标准响应，不承载任意复杂表单。
FIGMA VERIFIED / NATIVE IDS CONFIRMED / QT RUNTIME EVIDENCE OPEN
QDialog 窗口壳：Modeless、WindowModal、ApplicationModal；accept / reject / done 与 finished 负责完成语义。
Modal 不是第三个 Qt 类，而是 Dialog 的受控模态合同：遮罩、关闭策略、默认按钮、焦点范围和异步完成。
QMessageBox：主文案、informative text、details、severity icon、standard buttons、default / escape button。
ComponentLab/Dialog 提供 12 个变体、4 个公开属性与 36 个 canonical Button 实例；ComponentLab/MessageDialog 提供 10 个变体、3 个公开属性与 20 个 canonical Button 实例。共 22 个变体、56 个规范实例和 20 个已描述、专用作用域、直接绑定且具 WEB 语法的变量。
open / show 立即返回；通过 finished、accepted、rejected 收口。exec 的嵌套事件循环不是默认实现。
按钮顺序由平台样式和 ButtonRole 决定；Enter 只能有一个 default，Esc 必须映射唯一 escape 结果。
main、informative、detailed text 分层；details 是显式展开内容，长文本、富文本和可复制策略必须声明。
Question / Information / Warning / Critical 主要由平台图标区分；图标颜色不能替代可访问语义。
必须提供 parent 以保持定位与堆叠；WindowModal 只阻断父窗口，ApplicationModal 阻断整个应用。
标题栏关闭、Esc、按钮角色、程序化 reject 与销毁是不同原因；脏数据拦截必须独立建模。

ComponentLab/Dialog 直接映射 Z_Dialog / QDialog；ComponentLab/MessageDialog 直接映射 Z_MessageBox / QMessageBox。两者复用已治理的 DialogButtonGroup / Button 资产，并由 20 个直接绑定变量统一表面、焦点、遮罩、严重度和间距。Figma 按钮顺序仅为示例，运行时仍以 QStyle、ButtonRole、defaultButton 与 escapeButton 为权威。
• Figma：变体、属性、规范按钮实例、长文本、详情展开与四配置通过。
• MessageDialog：severity、standardButtons、details、clickedButton、custom role 与纯文本/富文本策略通过。
• 证据：四配置真实 Qt 截图、键盘、焦点、屏幕边缘、RTL、DPI 与辅助技术通过。

pages.name: 20.9.02 · StatusBar / 状态栏
galleries: States · default / hover / selected / disabled / custom
UCD CORE · WINDOW SYSTEM · NATIVE QT
A QMainWindow status surface for temporary messages, normal indicators, permanent widgets, and the optional size grip.
FIGMA VERIFIED / NATIVE ID CONFIRMED / QT RUNTIME EVIDENCE OPEN
Status information inside the main-window chrome

Temporary messages replace normal indicators for a bounded time. Normal indicators may be obscured. Permanent widgets remain visible. Message and Notification stay separate viewport-level feedback channels.
showMessage(text, timeout); removed by timeout, clearMessage, or a later message.
Left-side status widgets such as page, line, selection, or connection state; may be obscured.
Right-side mode indicators such as encoding, insert mode, sync, or task status; never obscured.

Six variants cover Idle, Temporary, and Composite scenarios with size grip shown or hidden. Three public properties, 12 canonical Label instances, and 10 scoped StatusBar variables are governed; nine bind directly and Focus is reserved for focusable child widgets.
ComponentLab/StatusBar · 6 variants · 3 properties · 12 canonical Label instances · 10 scoped variables

QStatusBar → commonWidget::Z_StatusBar → ComponentLab/StatusBar. Repository source, generated SDK header, four-profile QSS resources, and delivery-manifest entries exist. Runtime screenshots and behavior tests remain open.

showMessage(message, timeout), clearMessage, currentMessage, messageChanged, addWidget/insertWidget/removeWidget, addPermanentWidget/insertPermanentWidget, stretch, and sizeGripEnabled remain authoritative. Removed widgets are hidden, not deleted. The Focus token applies only to focusable child widgets.

Verify temporary messages hide normal indicators but never permanent widgets; timeout and clear rules; parent ownership; stretch geometry; focusable-child outlines and accessibility; QMainWindow integration; four runtime profiles; DPI, localization, RTL, and platform style behavior.

pages.name: 20.9.03 · System Pickers / 系统选择器
galleries: States · default / hover / selected / disabled / custom
UCD CORE · WINDOW SYSTEM · PLATFORM PICKERS
File, color, and font selection contracts that preserve native-platform ownership while defining deterministic Qt fallbacks.
FIGMA VERIFIED / NATIVE IDS CONFIRMED / PLATFORM VISUAL PARITY NOT CLAIMED
Native selection contracts, not generic form widgets

FileDialog chooses files or directories; ColorDialog chooses a QColor; FontDialog chooses a QFont. Native and Qt-widget surfaces may differ. Figma specifies intent, result, cancel, live-preview, permissions, and fallback behavior.
Open, multi-open, save, and directory intents; filters, schemes, overwrite, state provenance, and permissions.
Current versus selected color, alpha, live/no-buttons mode, custom colors, eyedropper, and cancel rollback.
Current versus selected font, scalable/mono/proportional filters, live/no-buttons mode, and cancel rollback.

Each set separates platform-native ownership from the deterministic Qt-widget fallback. Across 24 variants, 10 editable properties, 48 canonical Button instances, and 12 scoped variables, 10 tokens bind directly; Warning and host-owned Scrim remain explicit runtime boundaries.
ComponentLab/FileDialog · 8 variants · 4 properties · 16 canonical Button instances
ComponentLab/ColorDialog · 8 variants · 3 properties · 16 canonical Button instances
ComponentLab/FontDialog · 8 variants · 3 properties · 16 canonical Button instances

QFileDialog, QColorDialog, and QFontDialog map to commonWidget::Z_* classes with generated SDK headers, four-profile QSS resources, and delivery-manifest entries. Pixel parity with OS-native panels is intentionally not claimed.
Options must be set before showing

Prefer platform-native dialogs when supported. DontUseNativeDialog selects the deterministic Qt fallback. Native surfaces may ignore widget-only customization, titles, font filters, custom color APIs, or non-local schemes. Warning feedback remains runtime-owned; the modal Scrim belongs to the host. Cancel preserves the original value or returns an invalid/empty result as defined by Qt.

Verify open/show/exec choice, Accepted/Rejected results, current-versus-selected signals, native/fallback behavior, filters, permissions, overwrite, alpha, live preview, cancel rollback, focus restoration, localization, RTL, multi-monitor, DPI, and all four runtime profiles.

pages.name: 20.9.04 · Input & Progress Dialogs / 输入与进度对话框
galleries: States · default / hover / selected / disabled / custom
UCD CORE · WINDOW SYSTEM · SPECIALIZED DIALOGS
Single-value acquisition and long-operation feedback contracts built from canonical input, progress, and button assets.
FIGMA VERIFIED / NATIVE IDS CONFIRMED / QT RUNTIME EVIDENCE OPEN
Acquire one value or report one long-running operation

InputDialog collects one text, number, item, or multiline value and distinguishes changed from selected. ProgressDialog reports task progress, predicts whether it should appear, exposes cancellation, and never owns the worker task.
Text, multiline, item, integer, and double entry; range, step, precision, echo mode, live change, accepted selection, and explicit OK state.
Determinate or busy progress; minimumDuration, modal/modeless use, cancellation, autoReset, autoClose, re-entrancy, and worker ownership.

InputDialog and ProgressDialog compose canonical Input, Select, SpinBox, PlainTextEdit, Progress, and Button assets. Across 14 variants, eight public properties, 28 canonical nested instances, and 12 scoped variables, 11 tokens bind directly; the modal Scrim remains host-owned.
ComponentLab/InputDialog · 10 variants · 4 properties · 10 canonical field instances · 10 canonical Button instances
ComponentLab/ProgressDialog · 4 variants · 4 properties · 4 canonical Progress instances · 4 canonical Button instances

QInputDialog and QProgressDialog map to commonWidget::Z_* classes in both generated SDK and delivery outputs, with four-profile QSS resources and manifest entries. The wrappers currently add identity metadata but no custom behavior.
Current values are not committed selections

InputDialog Changed signals describe the current edit while Selected signals require acceptance; cancellation is observed separately. ProgressDialog cancellation requests task abort but does not stop worker code. minimumDuration suppresses short-task flashing, and modal setValue can process events and re-enter application code. The modal Scrim is owned by the host.

Verify all five input conveniences, ranges, steps, precision, echo, list editability, NoButtons, Changed/Selected signals, Accepted/Rejected results, minimumDuration, range/value, busy state, cancel, autoReset/autoClose, modal/modeless behavior, ownership, localization, RTL, keyboard, accessibility, DPI, and all four runtime profiles.
